//: The documented shape for this runtime: functions, not builds. composer.json must sit beside this file, which is why the Vercel project's Root Directory has to be 'site' — at the repository root there is no composer.json and no vercel.json, so Vercel guesses, builds nothing, and reports 'No Output Directory named public'.
//routes: Everything reaches Laravel through api/index.php. Only genuine static files are routed to public/ — index.php and where.php live there too, and routing to them would serve PHP source as plain text.
